attr.title: Akuji the Demon
attr.desc: A source port of Buster's 2001 freeware action-platformer. Stripped of his powers by a hero, the demon Akuji fights through one large castle to win them back from its bosses.
attr.inst: Ready to run. No additional files needed. The original Windows gm.dls bank is optional; copy your own into assets/soundfonts/ if you want it.
